1.

God in love the Son hath given For a world in sins sunk down; He on the cross was hanged, Many sins there He bore.

2.

Rule shall death no more, Jesus liveth, life He giveth; Prince of life Christ is, Life’s crown He bestoweth.

3.

Lion of Judah’s tribe, Jesus, God’s risen Lamb, Now in glory’s height Is He God’s chiefest joy.

4.

All who on Christ believe Have eternal life and rest, And they shall Him see Come soon in the clouds.

5.

O, what glorious grace-light Shineth forth in the Saviour To proclaim to the sinner here: God is both light and love.
